C08-M11-L06-F1.title: Measure workflow stages and outcomes
C08-M11-L06-F1.caption: Stages have different timestamps and need matching evidence for a useful operational metric.
C08-M11-L06-F1.alt: Five rows describe intake receipt to assignment, approval request to decision, accepted action to observed effect, effect to verification, and quality audit against unique cases.
C08-M11-L06-F1.note: Record pending work and the cutoff alongside completed-case metrics.
